metadata.description: Portable engineering workflows for investigating repositories, planning useful fixes, and verifying that those fixes work.

plugins.name: repo-audit-accessibility-state
plugins.description: Audit accessibility state consistency with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing divergence between UI state, focus, keyboard behavior, ARIA state, or screen-reader announcements.

plugins.name: repo-audit-api-consistency
plugins.description: Audit api design consistency with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing inconsistent API semantics, cancellation behavior, result types, pagination, or lifecycle conventions.

plugins.name: repo-audit-architecture
plugins.description: Audit architectural boundaries and dependency direction with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing dependency cycles, layer violations, module boundary erosion, forbidden imports, or dependency direction.

plugins.name: repo-audit-behavioral-contracts
plugins.description: Audit behavioral contract reconstruction with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when reconstructing subsystem behavioral contracts across state, time, ownership, correctness, resilience, and trust.

plugins.name: repo-audit-boundary-conditions
plugins.description: Audit boundary-condition correctness with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing empty inputs, limits, off-by-one errors, numeric overflow, Unicode, or malformed boundary values.

plugins.name: repo-audit-cache-coherence
plugins.description: Audit cache coherence with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing stale caches, invalidation races, cache keys, tenant leakage through caches, or competing cache layers.

plugins.name: repo-audit-cancellation
plugins.description: Audit cancellation propagation with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing abort propagation, cancelled tasks that keep running, stale publication after cancellation, or shutdown draining.

plugins.name: repo-audit-canonicalization
plugins.description: Audit security-sensitive canonicalization with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing URL/path/Unicode normalization, ambiguous encodings, allowlist bypasses, or parser disagreement.

plugins.name: repo-audit-capacity
plugins.description: Audit resource bounds and backpressure with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing unbounded memory, queues, retries, fan-out, polling, backpressure, or resource exhaustion.

plugins.name: repo-audit-cohesion
plugins.description: Audit cohesion and responsibility with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing mixed module responsibilities, unrelated reasons to change, god objects, or weak cohesion.

plugins.name: repo-audit-compatibility
plugins.description: Audit compatibility and migration contracts with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing breaking persisted-state changes, migrations, older-client compatibility, or rolling deployment contracts.

plugins.name: repo-audit-complexity
plugins.description: Audit algorithmic complexity with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing pathological input costs, quadratic work, excessive allocations, or algorithmic denial of service.

plugins.name: repo-audit-concurrency
plugins.description: Audit concurrency and race conditions with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing races, stale asynchronous results, reentrancy, lost updates, or unsafe overlapping operations.

plugins.name: repo-audit-configuration
plugins.description: Audit configuration combinatorics with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing invalid feature-flag combinations, configuration precedence, environment drift, or unsafe configuration transitions.

plugins.name: repo-audit-data-integrity
plugins.description: Audit data transformation integrity with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing lossy mappings, serialization errors, precision loss, provenance gaps, or parser-to-model data corruption.

plugins.name: repo-audit-dead-code
plugins.description: Audit dead code and obsolete compatibility paths with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing unreachable code, abandoned flags, unused exports, obsolete migrations, or removable compatibility paths.

plugins.name: repo-audit-diagnostics
plugins.description: Diagnose stalled repository audits, parse session transcripts for timeouts and schema errors, scrub credentials, and generate recovery bundles.

plugins.name: repo-audit-domain-models
plugins.description: Audit implicit domain models with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing primitive obsession, ambiguous identifiers or units, invalid domain combinations, or missing domain concepts.

plugins.name: repo-audit-error-semantics
plugins.description: Audit error semantics and taxonomy with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing swallowed errors, error classification, incorrect recovery, misleading failures, or exception propagation.

plugins.name: repo-audit-failure-modes
plugins.description: Audit failure-mode completeness with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing partial failures, timeouts, recovery gaps, interrupted workflows, or failure transition completeness.

plugins.name: repo-audit-idempotency
plugins.description: Audit idempotency and replay safety with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing duplicate deliveries, unsafe retries, repeated initialization, replay handling, or idempotency keys.

plugins.name: repo-audit-invariants
plugins.description: Audit implicit invariants with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when investigating unenforced domain rules, invariant violations, or invalid combinations of domain values.

plugins.name: repo-audit-lifecycle
plugins.description: Audit ownership and lifecycle boundaries with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing resource ownership, missing cleanup, use after disposal, leaked listeners, streams, timers, or tasks.

plugins.name: repo-audit-nondeterminism
plugins.description: Audit nondeterministic behavior with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing flaky tests, clock/randomness dependence, global state leakage, or order-sensitive workflows.

plugins.name: repo-audit-observability
plugins.description: Audit observability gaps with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing undiagnosable failures, missing correlation, misleading telemetry, or insufficient recovery visibility.

plugins.name: repo-audit-program
plugins.description: Coordinate comprehensive repository audits for hidden behavioral contracts. Use when a user requests a multi-topic architecture/correctness audit or this three-pass audit program.

plugins.name: repo-audit-protocol-drift
plugins.description: Audit protocol contract drift with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing producer-consumer disagreement, wire format drift, message versioning, or incompatible protocol assumptions.

plugins.name: repo-audit-side-effects
plugins.description: Audit hidden side effects with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when investigating unexpected mutations, hidden I/O, effectful getters, render effects, or misleading function contracts.

plugins.name: repo-audit-sources-of-truth
plugins.description: Audit duplicated sources of truth with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing duplicated domain state, conflicting authorities, independently maintained derived fields, or divergent projections.

plugins.name: repo-audit-state-machines
plugins.description: Audit implicit state machines with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when finding implicit state machines, invalid state combinations, missing transitions, or state-dependent behavior.

plugins.name: repo-audit-synthesis
plugins.description: Consolidate repository audit findings into deduplicated root causes, issue drafts, and ordered implementation handoffs. Use after one or more audits or when converting audit reports into an issue plan.

plugins.name: repo-audit-temporal-coupling
plugins.description: Audit temporal coupling with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when investigating hidden call-order dependencies, startup/shutdown order, initialization sequencing, or typestate contracts.

plugins.name: repo-audit-test-contracts
plugins.description: Audit untested behavioral contracts with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when mapping missing behavioral tests, contract coverage gaps, or inadequate negative and recovery path coverage.

plugins.name: repo-audit-test-oracles
plugins.description: Audit test oracle quality with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing assertions that mirror implementation, ineffective mocks, weak expected results, or surviving mutations.

plugins.name: repo-audit-transactions
plugins.description: Audit implicit transaction boundaries with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when auditing multi-step consistency, partial commits, transaction scope, dual writes, or compensation guarantees.

plugins.name: repo-audit-trust-boundaries
plugins.description: Audit trust and authorization boundaries with code evidence and counterexamples. Use when mapping untrusted inputs, authorization bypasses, tenant isolation, or security boundary enforcement.
